correctness.rationale: For positive homogeneous NIMFA SIS on connected four-node three-edge graphs there are only K_1,3 and P4. Uniqueness of positive fixed point uses strict positive concavity of f(z)=τz/(1+τz), forcing graph automorphism symmetry. The star solution x=(3τ²-1)/(τ(3τ+1)), y=(3τ²-1)/(3τ(τ+1)) exists iff τ>1/sqrt(3). Path solution q=sqrt(τ(τ+1)), u=1-1/q and v=(q-1)/τ exists iff τ>(sqrt(5)-1)/2. The exact positive sign identity B(τ)²-τ/(τ+1)=((τ+1)^3-4τ³)/((τ+1)²(3τ+1)²) yields one crossover τ*=(2^(2/3)-1)^(-1), and P-S=1/(3τ)+O(τ^-2). Checked fixed point equations independently and examined source symbolic checker; physical zero branch correctly distinguished from absorbing stochastic SIS.
